Match Summary

Everton secured a significant victory in the Carabao Cup, defeating Newcastle United with a final score of 3-1. The match, which took place under the evening lights, was highlighted by a standout performance from midfielder Hayden Hackney.

Performance Highlights

Following the completion of the match, Hackney spoke about the physical and mental demands of the fixture. Key takeaways from his comments regarding the team's performance include:

  • Tactical Resilience: Hackney noted that despite taking a 2-0 lead, the squad expected a strong push from Newcastle. He credited the team's defensive efforts and crucial blocks for maintaining the lead.
  • Individual Contribution: The match marked the first goal for Hackney at his current club. He expressed satisfaction with the milestone, attributing his readiness to consistent hard work during his time as a substitute.
  • Atmosphere: The midfielder praised the fan support, describing the environment at the venue as a significant factor in the team's ability to compete against Premier League opposition.

Context of the Result

This victory represents a notable advancement in the competition for Everton. While the match is now classified as completed, Hackney emphasized that the result serves as a foundation for future performances. He expressed a desire to build upon this momentum in upcoming fixtures.
